source: docs/design-contract.md (current contract; this file records the A4j scale proposal)
note: scale = the adjustable tokens; roles = every token row of sections 3.1 and 3.2 with its step. today lists the old values the step replaces. recommended null = no such step in R; alternative null = no such step in Alt. 3.2 rows are locked (decisions.md, Bar insets and chrome tokens).

exceptions.name: BadgeTopPadding 1, BadgeBottomPadding 2
exceptions.reason: Optical centering of 12 px text in a 20 px badge; not a gap

exceptions.name: PagerCountDigitWidth 14
exceptions.reason: Width of a digit in the count text, a font measurement, not a spacing

exceptions.name: TopBackdrop stops 40 / 52, blur 10, tint .4, mask alphas
exceptions.reason: Lab-tuned and locked in decisions.md; part of one gradient

exceptions.name: Checkbox renderer: size x .86, radius x .28, pens 1.6 / 1.9
exceptions.reason: Drawn in proportion to the editor font size

exceptions.name: DrawChip font x .93 and widths
exceptions.reason: Tracks the editor font size, not the UI scale

exceptions.name: Nudge 2 (box extra, toast clearance, Seg gap, line gaps)
exceptions.reason: Hairline gaps between 0 and 4; Fluent keeps 2 for icon alignment

exceptions.name: Toast and dialog action pad 8 x 2
exceptions.reason: Compact text buttons sit in a bar of 32 high; full 12 x 4 would crowd the toast

exceptions.name: Search query radius Md 8
exceptions.reason: Prominent 16 px input; matches the overlay card it sits on

exceptions.name: Accent dot selected ring colored Ink, not Accent
exceptions.reason: The dot is itself the accent color; the ring has to differ

exceptions.name: Editor Bold weight (markdown headings, **bold**)
exceptions.reason: The user's content, not chrome; Fluent's no-Bold rule is for UI

exceptions.name: Material picture (no radius), pager PillHeight 42 and strip 50
exceptions.reason: Sample art; derived from button 32 + inset + border, kept so the lock holds

exceptions.name: Drawn sample and glyph alphas as bytes (220, 110, 90, 40)
exceptions.reason: Painted into bitmaps and glyph color, not UI washes

exceptions.name: Icon button hover radius Md 8 on a 32 square
exceptions.reason: Locked hover radii (8, and 9 to 8 under R); bigger than Control 4 on purpose
